facts.methodology: Bounded historical approximation; separate geography and administrative facts. See supplement provenance.

features.boundary_note: Hail, Qassim and Riyadh under the same Rashidi administration. Western/eastern desert edges are inferred regional limits, not exact national borders; no 1902 Saudi entity.
Small port/peninsula core. Sheikh Othman hinterland and the exact 1900 settlement perimeter are not asserted.
Aggregated Lahij, Fadhli, Yafa, Aulaqi and Wahidi treaty region; no unified sovereign Aden Protectorate and no later 1904 demarcation imported. Individual tribal internal frontiers unresolved.
features.source_name: Aden treaty states / Wahidi coastal belt

features.boundary_note: Seiyun and Tarim valley core, separated from Quaiti Shibam and ports. Regional envelope is approximate. The 1918 protection agreement is not backdated.
Quaiti coastal towns and Shibam valley connection described by Bent and Zwemer; all inland limits approximate. Excludes the separately traced Kathiri core.
Mahra coastal/core region adjoining Hadramaut, under the 1886 protection relationship; no modern Yemen-Oman boundary used.
Conservative Kuwait bay/coastal hinterland; not the 1922 Uqair boundary, modern Kuwait outline or a claim over the later neutral zone. Bay follows historical map coast.
Historical peninsula coastal outline; southern cut is an approximate geographic neck, not the later internationally delimited border. No modern reclamation geometry.

Main island, Muharraq, Sitra and Umm Nassan generalized from the 1900 island map; excludes modern causeways, airport extensions and reclaimed islands. Small islands not charted here remain unresolved.
Physical land closure only; no exclusive polity/administrator inferred over undelimited desert and tribal areas.

facts.methodology: Natural Earth physical connected parts clipped to fixed Lambert-93 50 km cells selected by the dated France record. Coordinates of the political or administrative borders are not copied into land. Retain Paris, refine only non-simple physical parts to 25/5 km, reject sub-1 km2 new fragments.

source_geometry.source_scale: Natural Earth 1:10,000,000; generated coarse game partition
source_geometry.water_policy: GENERALIZED_PHYSICAL_MASK; inland waters not classified; existing Paris surfaces retained
source_geometry.international_edge_policy: Cells can straddle dated borders; unresolved sovereignty/control are explicit and no foreign-state simulation is created.

projection.basis: RGF93 / Lambert-93, GRS80; fixed national projection. WGS84/RGF93 approximation about 1m, not survey-level conversion.

initial_politics.sovereignty_basis: HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE: the 1900 Paris and environs guide and existing French political identity support this bounded Paris basin scope. Physical mainland inclusion supplies no sovereignty or administration.
initial_politics.controller_basis: INITIAL_WORLD_ASSUMPTION: France controls this bounded Paris basin opening scope on 1900-01-01. No universal controller=sovereign rule.
initial_politics.source_locator: Baedeker Paris and its environs, 14th English edition, 1900; existing Paris Local evidence / Versailles source leaf 427
